 Mr. Pramod Tiwari, Brief Holder for the State.

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
Applicant is in judicial custody in Fir No.164 of 2023, under Sections 420 and 120B Ipc, Police
Station Gadarpur, District Udham Singh Nagar.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
It is a case of online fraud.
According to the informant, on 02.06.2023, somebody called him introducing himself as the son of the friend of the informant and demanded money.
As indicated by the caller, according to the FIR, the informant transmitted Rs.7,66,000/- in different accounts.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant is not related to any offence.
No account number pertains to the applicant and no mobile number belongs to him.
The applicant is not the beneficiary.
The applicant has been implicated merely on the basis of the statement of the co-accused.
5. Learned State Counsel would submit that as per one Suraj, his account were got opened by the applicant.
When money was deposited, one Arif withdrew the money and gave it to the applicant.
He would submit that the co-accused have given those statements of the Investigating Officer.
6. Learned State Counsel admits that neither any bank account nor any mobile number belongs to the applicant.

1 7. Having considered the entirety of facts, this Court is of the view that the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
